steps.content: You are pinned down by the blue light and lose the strength to raise your head. Meanwhile, footsteps echo across the ground, drawing closer.
The sound bears an unnatural weight, accompanied by the grinding of metal joints. You realize it must be a massive cyborg approaching.
A cold metallic hand grabs your collar and hoists you up. You come face-to-face with a metal mask, yet from beneath it, you hear steady, deep breathing.

It's a person. One that's bold enough to strike at the MBCC in broad daylight, utilizing a cyborg to seize you right in front of everyone. Quite the opposite of those sweet-talking councilors caught up in their political mind games.
There's no doubt about it—this must be the same perpetrator behind the FAC assault and possibly the cabinet attack. They exhibit the same merciless brutality and utter disregard for consequences.
You are lifted, feet off the ground, but you still force out a question through gritted teeth.

options: ...Are you the one who attacked the cabinet and killed Stewart?

steps.speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
steps.content: Oh, investigating that case, are you? Bold, but naive, I must say.

steps.speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
steps.content: No wonder someone resorts to us to take your life.
His voice is consumed by heavy mechanical distortion, yet miraculously, those words reverberate within your skull, allowing you to understand everything he says.

steps.speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
steps.content: You've caught the attention of some pests. Need any help?

steps.speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
steps.content: We've done our own verification. We can discuss a potential partnership.
You strain to make out the figure before you. It's probably a man. He towers over you, his massive frame extensively covered in metal.
The restraint binding you appears akin to anti-Mania technology, yet the method employed to control S9... undeniably emanated from an immensely potent Mania power.
Your gaze shifts to S9 on the ground. She has remained motionless for a while now, with electric sparks flickering amidst her mechanical joints where blood slowly seeps through.
Too weak to call out to her, you slowly raise your hand.

options: I don't work with those who harm my allies.

steps.content: A red light spike hurtles towards the man's neck. Despite depleting your last ounces of strength, the spike barely skims the only exposed part of his skin, leaving behind a thin trail of blood.
Then, as if in response to an unseen force, the thin bloodline starts to widen, turning into a horizontal gash, and then... into some blazing red marks you know all too well.
The man offers you no answer. He simply wipes the blood from his neck, a smile playing across his face.

steps.speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
steps.content: Heh... You’ve got some backbone. I suppose I’ll take you back—she favors people like you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I—Argh!
Without waiting for your response, he slams you violently against the ground. Your head rings from the impact, blood catching in your throat, leaving you unable to utter another word.
Shadowy figures materialize one by one from above, looming over you. Their leader approaches and raises their foot over your right hand—the very hand you just used to unleash the shackles.

steps.speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
steps.content: Shackles of the Underground... even if we break your limbs, you can still use that power, right?

steps.speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
steps.content: We'll have you fixed.
You have no strength left to resist. Just as his foot comes crashing down, a figure suddenly lunges over, pushing the man back a pace. Droplets of her blood splatter across your face.
With her battered body, S9 struggles to restrain the towering man. Just before she's completely vanquished, a faint light flickers across her body as if some program is activated.
In her last moments, she turns to gaze at you, and beneath her fractured mask, human eyes meet yours for the first time.

steps.speaker: S9
steps.content: Tell... Elvira... I...
[BOOM!!]
Thrown several meters back by the blast wave, you fade into complete unconsciousness.

steps.speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
steps.content: Heh, a lackey of the powers... you do have some guts.
With his coat burnt away, the man removes the mechanical debris clinging to his body. S9's minor self-destruction has scarcely wounded him, yet...
Not far away, another figure slowly approaches.

steps.speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
steps.content: ...Oh right, I almost forgot. There's still you behind her...
